summary: Full e2e testing of Bankezee CRM (JWT auth, leads sync, assignment, notes/timeline, role isolation, partner directory). 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; 10/11 Playwright UI cases pass. Sole UI failure is a case-sensitive text assertion in the Partners cards check (cards actually render correctly with 6 partners visible; API confirms).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 302: partner query-param overrides the role-scoped filter (query['assigned_partner_id']) applied earlier. Admin behaviour is fine, but if a growth_partner were ever to hit /api/leads?partner=someone_else, the earlier scoping would be overwritten. Currently unreachable via UI, but consider merging conditions instead of overwriting.

server.py cookie is set with samesite='none' and secure=True which is correct for cross-site preview URL, but frontend also stores session_token in localStorage and sends Bearer — dual auth is fine, just ensure logout deletes both. Currently /api/auth/logout only deletes the DB session; localStorage cleanup depends on frontend (verified working).
Initial sheet import happens on startup only when leads collection is empty; not idempotent-safe if collection is truncated while server keeps unique index — fine due to sparse unique on sheet_id.
No pagination on GET /api/leads (hard cap 2000). At scale this needs pagination.
Partners endpoint doesn't require admin role; a growth_partner can list all partners with their assigned/converted counts. Consider restricting to admin or removing sensitive counts.

success_rate.frontend: 91% (10/11, remaining failure is test-string case-sensitivity, not a product bug)

test_credentials: Admin sasha.sgchr@gmail.com / Admin@123456. Registered ephemeral partners each run (TEST_partner_* / uitest_*).
seed_data_creation: Auto-registered fresh growth_partner via /api/auth/register in both pytest and UI runs. Assigned one lead to the test partner. Added TEST_UI_NOTE_* to one lead and moved status to CONTACTED. Prior seeded partners partner1/ravi/priya remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o 'addopts='` (pytest.ini enables xdist LoadScope which breaks session fixtures split across workers, so use -o 'addopts=' to disable). Google Sheet CSV import is real & network-dependent; sync test just verifies keys, not counts. Admin dashboard shows 238 leads at time of test.
